proposed.choice: Keep repository definitions, local agent guidance, CLI and operational custody as distinct local authority boundaries.
proposed.rationale: The primary deployment is one local checkout, one user and one or more agents. Engineering meaning remains readable from Git; operational history and bulky artifacts have separate custody.
alternatives: Make a local operational database necessary to understand the repository.
Treat SQLite or an agent process as a new logical Module.
consequences: Canonical rem/ methods and skills/ sources feed a versioned package candidate; bounded installation supplies guidance to the local agent.
The local agent edits the Git-held model and uses supported CLI operations for operational facts; no new hosted service is assumed.
Deployment describes proposed placement, not backup/restore qualification or implementation of the SQLite migration.
revisit_when: Supported deployment or operational-store compatibility is redesigned.
